page_title: JUV 2-2 FIO | Juventus v Fiorentina 29/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+3' Juventus are awarded a free kick from long range.
90+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by David de Gea.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Federico Gatti will be replaced by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus).
89' That will be all from Khephren Thuram who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
87' 2 - 2 Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) finds the back of the net with a rocket of a volley that goes into the top left corner!
87' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
85' A yellow card for a tackle by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina). Maurizio Mariani doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
84' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Kenan Yildiz. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
82' Dusan Vlahovic goes off the pitch and Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) comes on.
82' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
80' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
77' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) was probably a bit loose with his words to Maurizio Mariani, who decides to show him a yellow.
76' Dodo (Fiorentina) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
76' A header by Federico Gatti (Juventus) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past David de Gea, who makes a nice save.
76' Juventus win a corner.
75' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Yacine Adli and he is replaced by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is replacing Fabiano Parisi.
75' Substitution. Andrea Colpani makes way for Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
73' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sprays a pass out to Dusan Vlahovic, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
72' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
69' The game is interrupted. Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
69' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

68' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Dodo (Fiorentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Fiorentina get a corner.
65' A substitution has been made. Danilo Cataldi goes off and Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) comes on.
64' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is cleared to safety by the defence.
63' Samuel Mbangula will be replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
62' Here is a change. Weston McKennie is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
61' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
59' It's time for a substitution. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Albert Gudmundsson.
59' Weston McKennie (Juventus) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
58' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) launches a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is alert to thwart the effort.
57' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
53' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
48' 2 - 1 Goal! Teun Koopmeiners puts the ball on a plate for Khephren Thuram (Juventus), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:1.
48' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Referee Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
45+1' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Federico Gatti (Juventus) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
43' The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.
43' David de Gea (Fiorentina) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
42' David de Gea (Fiorentina) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but David de Gea pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
41' Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul after Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

38' 1 - 1 Goal! Yacine Adli plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header low into the middle of the goal from close range. 1:1.
38' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
38' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
36' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Khephren Thuram (Juventus), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
36' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
35' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Half-chance! Dodo (Fiorentina) plays a pass into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio reacts well to snuff out the attack.
32' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
29' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
28' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
27' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) trips an opposition player and Maurizio Mariani signals a foul. Fiorentina earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
26' The ball possession is 71:29.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Dodo (Fiorentina).
24' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
22' Dusan Vlahovic receives a sweet cross inside the box from Samuel Mbangula (Juventus), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.

20' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Khephren Thuram (Juventus) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:0. David de Gea was helpless.
18' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) whips the ball into the box and Dusan Vlahovic takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
17' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
14' The corner from Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio.

12' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Albert Gudmundsson was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
10' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
9' An attempted cross from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
6' An accurate cross into the centre of the box from Francisco Conceicao gives Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) a clear sight of goal, but he sends his headed effort narrowly wide of the left post.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
2' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and it's Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
